claude_proposed_widenings.name: turn_start_repeating_save_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Tsunami fires a save gate at the start of each caster turn for the spell's duration (6 rounds). No existing spell family models a save gate that recurs on a turn-start trigger. ongoing_effect operations are limited to roll_modifier and damage_on_hit; activation is one-shot. A new subgraph or family is needed: a persistent spell that opens a turn_start_window, which prompts a save_gate each turn.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: At the start of each of your turns after the wall appears, the wall, along with any creatures in it, moves 50 feet away from you. Any Huge or smaller creature inside the wall or whose space the wall enters when it moves must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 5d10 Bludgeoning damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: linear_per_round (LevelAxis: 'round')
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Tsunami's recurring damage decreases by 1d10 per round elapsed: 5d10 → 4d10 → 3d10 → 2d10 → 1d10 → 0. The existing LevelAxis enum ('character' | 'class' | 'slot' | 'subclass' | 'proficiency_bonus') has no 'round' axis. LinearPerLevel<T> with a perLevel decrement could model this, but the axis is missing. Adding axis: 'round' to LevelAxis and supporting negative perLevel on DiceAmount would cover this pattern.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the damage the wall deals on later rounds is reduced by 1d10. When the wall reaches 0 feet in height, the spell ends.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ability_check phase / operation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Creatures inside the wall must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check against the caster's spell save DC in order to move. This is an ability_check (v4 atom exists in taxonomy) gating movement, not a saving throw and not an attack roll. Neither ActivationPhase nor OngoingOperation has an ability_check variant. The surface needs either a new ActivationPhase kind or a new OngoingOperation kind for 'ability_check_gate'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the creature must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to move at all. If it fails the check, it can't move.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: moving_area attachment or lifecycle atom
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The wall moves 50 feet away from the caster at the start of each caster turn. No existing Attachment type (self, target, area, mark) models a spatially-moving area. The area's position is dynamic, not fixed at cast time. This requires either a new Attachment variant (moving_area with a per-turn displacement) or a new lifecycle atom (e.g., translate or drift) that modifies an area's origin on each turn.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the wall, along with any creatures in it, moves 50 feet away from you.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: fall_on_exit lifecycle / forced_move effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Creatures that exit the wall fall to the ground. The v4 taxonomy has fall_on_end (lifecycle) and force_move (effect), but neither maps cleanly to 'fall when a creature moves out of an area voluntarily.' This is an on-exit trigger tied to the area boundary, not to spell end.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature that moves out of the wall falls to the ground.
